name: PROOF-CARRYING-EXECUTION-FABRIC
purpose: A consequential action is complete only when it reaches VERIFIED then TERMINAL while carrying tamper-evident evidence. Returning process exit 0 is not verification.
truth_rule: No mission becomes VERIFIED by declaration. Verification requires committed output evidence to equal an independently supplied expected hash; otherwise the mission fails closed.
